content.value: Apply the linear momentum equation to determine the exerted force of free jet of water on series of symmetric curved vanes attached on large wheel. Show that the maximum efficiency reduces to $\scriptstyle { \frac { 1 } { 2 } } ( 1 + \cos \theta )$ , where e is the angle of tangent line of tips with the horizontal. State the assumptions you made.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
